detail.description: The most complete financial compliance agent in the x402 ecosystem. Combines verified TradFi data (GLEIF LEI, OpenFIGI FIGI), on-chain DeFi normalization, OFAC sanctions screening, and AML pattern detection — all in one pay-per-call agent on Base mainnet.

tools.name: normalize_financial_record
tools.description: Normalize raw TradFi records into structured JSON. Standardizes dates to ISO 8601, currencies to ISO 4217, infers asset class, flags anomalies. Supports FIX, SWIFT, ISO20022 target schemas.

raw_record.description: Raw financial record as a JSON string, CSV row, or free text. Example: {"symbol":"AAPL US","qty":"500","px":"198.42 USD","date":"04/10/26"}

record_type.description: The category of financial record being normalized.

target_schema.description: Optional target schema name for output formatting. Supported: FIX, SWIFT, ISO20022.

tools.name: normalize_onchain_transaction
tools.description: Normalize a raw on-chain/DeFi transaction into a TradFi-compatible record. Handles EVM tx hashes, DEX swaps (Uniswap, Curve), token transfers, bridges, NFT trades. Returns protocol, asset amounts, USD value estimate, and regulatory field mapping.

chain.description: The blockchain network where the transaction occurred.

raw_tx.description: Raw transaction as a hash string (0x...), JSON tx object, or DEX event log. Example: {"hash":"0x...","from":"0x...","to":"0xUniswapV3","value":"0"}

tx_type.description: Optional hint about the transaction type to improve classification accuracy.

reporting_standard.description: Optional target regulatory reporting standard for field mapping in the output.

tools.name: validate_regulatory_fields
tools.description: Check a financial record for regulatory completeness under MiFID II, Dodd-Frank, EMIR, or SEC Rule 605. Returns missing and invalid fields with remediation guidance.

record.description: The financial record to validate as a JSON object. Can be a TradFi record or a normalized DeFi transaction.

regulation.description: The target regulation to validate against. MiFID_II for EU, Dodd-Frank for US swaps, EMIR for EU derivatives, SEC_Rule_605 for US order execution.

tools.name: enrich_counterparty
tools.description: Verify a counterparty by legal name against the GLEIF Global LEI Index — the authoritative regulatory database used by central banks worldwide. Returns verified LEI code, jurisdiction, entity status, and registered address. Zero AI tokens on GLEIF hits.

counterparty_name.description: The full legal entity name of the counterparty to look up. Example: Goldman Sachs International

tools.name: lookup_instrument
tools.description: Resolve an ISIN, CUSIP, SEDOL, or ticker symbol to a verified FIGI code, exchange, and security type using the OpenFIGI database. Auto-detects identifier type from format. Zero AI tokens.

id_type.description: Optional: force a specific identifier type. If omitted, the type is auto-detected from the identifier format.

identifier.description: The instrument identifier to resolve. Accepts ISIN (12 chars, e.g. US0378331005), CUSIP (9 chars), SEDOL (7 chars), or ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL).

tools.name: resolve_wallet_identity
tools.description: Resolve a blockchain wallet address to an entity name, type, and risk context. Identifies known exchange hot wallets, protocol contracts, DAO treasuries, and labeled DeFi addresses. Essential for KYA (Know Your Agent/Address) workflows.

chain.description: The blockchain network the address exists on. Defaults to ethereum if not specified.

address.description: The EVM wallet or contract address to resolve (0x-prefixed hexadecimal). Example: 0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045

tools.name: screen_sanctions
tools.description: Screen counterparty names and blockchain wallet addresses against the OFAC SDN list, NONSDN Consolidated list, and UN Security Council sanctions in real-time. Uses fuzzy name matching (score 0-100) and native crypto address lookup. Returns match details, sanctions program, and required legal action.

names.description: List of entity or individual names to screen against sanctions lists. Example: ["Lazarus Group", "Kim Jong Un"]

min_score.description: Minimum fuzzy match confidence score threshold (0-100). Score 85 is recommended for production compliance. Lower values increase sensitivity but may produce false positives.

wallet_addresses.description: List of blockchain wallet addresses (EVM 0x format) to screen against the OFAC crypto address list. Example: ["0x098B716B8Aaf21512996dC57EB0615e2383E2f96"]

tools.name: detect_aml_patterns
tools.description: Analyze a set of financial transactions for Anti-Money Laundering red flags. Detects structuring (CTR threshold avoidance below $10k), smurfing, layering, velocity spikes, round-trip transactions, dormancy activation, and threshold avoidance. Returns risk score, risk level, flagged transactions, and SAR filing recommendation.

entity_name.description: Name of the entity being analyzed. Used for context in the pattern analysis and SAR recommendation.

to.description: Receiving account, wallet address, or entity identifier

from.description: Sending account, wallet address, or entity identifier

type.description: Transaction type (e.g. wire, transfer, swap, deposit)

amount.description: Transaction amount in the specified currency

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, USDC)

transactions.description: List of financial transactions to analyze. Each transaction should include id, amount, currency, date, from, to, and type fields. Accepts TradFi transactions, on-chain transfers, or mixed datasets.

lookback_days.description: Analysis window in days. Patterns are evaluated within this time window. Default is 30 days. Use 7 for weekly review, 90 for quarterly.
